name: Bakonytamási (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bakonytamási (a red and blue shield with bars, a wheel and a white bird) above the name BAKONYTAMÁSI in yellow.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
